scope: Synthetic Reed Camp at fictional Greywater Reach; not a historical rule or universal Rise profile.

counting.unit: One permanent building or one distinct committed new-building project at this settlement, counted once.
includes: admitted new-building projects whether active or paused
cancelled projects with retained physical works
excludes: ordinary repairs to the same building
counting.completion: Atomically replace the completed project's reservation with its building; total usage does not change.
counting.last_slot: At most one of two competing projects can be admitted into the last available place. Both may be deferred by conflict handling; no priority or immediate winner is specified. A later separately authorized attempt must revalidate the current state.
counting.cancellation: Before work, cancellation releases the place reservation and any outstanding unconsumed material reservation; stock is not credited because reserved material was never transferred. After work begins, the fictional proposal retains the place and physical works; release of any active material reservation follows the pending Engine work contract. There is no automatic refund.
counting.project_identity: A new distinct admitted project and its completed asset require separate stable identity and lineage. Completion converts its place reservation into exactly one building with valid project and material-flow provenance. The current Engine only has the hard-coded shelter project; general distinct identities are not yet implemented.
counting.opening_basis: Initial completed buildings are zero. A fixture needing one building must use an explicitly authored player-controlled prelude to complete a Core-valid project with its material flow before the evaluated actions. This is a proposed setup, not an existing-save migration or evidence that multiple projects are supported.

authority.issuer: fictional-reed-commons-council (proposed; not the existing R00 steward)
prerequisites: issuer is active and authorized for this settlement
request is within this fictional jurisdiction
the recorded site review permits one further building place
authority.decision: If a verified issuer/site prerequisite or eligible site review is absent, record refusal; otherwise the issuer may offer one additional place under this proposed authored procedure. Request or offer alone changes no allowance.
authority.terms: No fee, resource transfer, new land right, automatic approval, obligation or extra labor is implied. The founder must separately accept the still-valid offer; an effective grant changes the allowance at most once.
authority.validity: A wrong-site, expired or revoked authority cannot create a valid offer or grant. Later changes do not erase existing buildings or receipts.
authority.review_reuse: Proposed single-use rule: a favorable recorded review is bound to one issuer, site and review identity. It can support at most one live offer and one effective grant. Effective acceptance consumes its eligibility atomically; declined, expired or revoked offers require a newly recorded favorable review before another offer. A retry returns the original receipt. No expiry duration, reviewer procedure or renewal schedule is selected.
authority.record_requirements: Engine must define Core-owned authority, jurisdiction, recorded site review, scoped decision, offer/acceptance/expiry and effective grant records plus actor-safe receipts. The proposed council is not an existing R00 actor or authority; a claimant cannot gain jurisdiction by requesting it.

state_and_recovery.owner: Existing authoritative Core and applicable rights/work records; this document does not create a second state owner.
state_and_recovery.revalidation: At commit recheck issuer, site, current permission, allowance, physical fit and relevant resources.
state_and_recovery.failure: A rejected build or grant changes no materials, commitments, allowance or elapsed work.
state_and_recovery.retry: A repeated committed request returns its original actor-scoped result, without a second effect; restore fencing follows the Engine's eventual published contract.
state_and_recovery.migration: Existing saves must not receive an inferred allowance or silent rewrite; Engine must define an explicit migration and compatibility policy.

coordination.engine: Engine review ecca8094a2d2cdb8a11e018a085487288b26e88d: future distinct projects/assets, provenance, authority/review/offer/grant records, concurrency resolution and migration contracts are prerequisites; no adoption claimed.
coordination.app: App must consume only a reviewed, explicitly selected Engine/Catalog set; this proposal is not a launch or display authorization.
coordination.catalog: Catalog owns the fictional proposal and independent expectations; evaluator truth is not actor input.

supersedes_for_review: fictional-reed-building-allowance-v1 at Catalog 92998f768e699496711f9ec2238584216655f6b2; v1 remains historical and unselected

material_accounting.basis: Three synthetic prepared timber bundles per new project and nine opening bundles are example profile values; current R00 uses three per shelter and nine for its stocked setup. This proposal is not selected for an existing campaign.
material_accounting.admission: Admission reserves available, unconsumed timber for active work; reservation is not a physical transfer or debit.
material_accounting.pause: Pausing retains the distinct building-place reservation but releases the active unconsumed material reservation. A resume rechecks material availability and any required authority.
material_accounting.completion: Consume timber once only when completion commits, with valid material-flow lineage. Convert place reservation to completed asset without double counting.
material_accounting.cancellation: Release any outstanding material reservation without crediting stock. Already consumed or physically transferred material may not be credited a second time; subsequent disposition requires a separate reviewed contract.
material_accounting.dependencies: The distinct building-place reservation and cancellation procedure are proposed; their Engine data and atomic transitions are not yet published.

unresolved_choices.identity: Engine must specify distinct project and asset identities, completion lineage and validation before execution.
unresolved_choices.authority: Engine and Catalog must agree whether and how a fictional council relates to the existing steward, founding grant and actor knowledge; no automatic conversion is assumed.
unresolved_choices.review: Engine must review single-use review/offer/grant binding, cancellation, revocation, expiry events and renewal; no duration or automatic renewal is chosen.
unresolved_choices.concurrency: Host serialization or the later authorized resolution after R9 deferral must be specified; this proposal gives no winner or priority policy.
unresolved_choices.resources: Engine must specify place and material reservation representation, atomic completion and cancellation; paused unconsumed materials are free in the inspected R00.
unresolved_choices.migration: Engine must define saved-state compatibility and an explicit migration; no opening asset or cap may be silently injected.
unresolved_choices.disposition: Treatment of cancelled post-work physical remains and release of a place require a separately reviewed contract.
